subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers 1, 2, 5, 6, 8 and 9 are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure, Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 8?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ecf5eda925dccae17da34f235346595cb48b343f869116353fa226961c21131.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 6, 8, 5, and 2 are adjacent to it and the remaining number i.e., 3 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcc40cb1e459068159723872239980b9fef345a95f6815636ed1b18381679a97.png] 

Opposite pairs:

6 → 5

8 → 2

1 → 9

So, the opposite side of "8" will be side "2".

Hence, the correct answer is "2".
